summary: Completed M17 managed-workload UX: bounded cards, backend PREPARE review and explicit confirmation, safe lifecycle recovery, and UI-mounted bounded automatic observation.
completed: Device-detail managed-workload cards use only bounded read-only workload and deployment DTOs, and disable new preparation when backend state or same-device maintenance makes it ineligible.

PREPARE renders backend-provided review evidence, requires explicit confirmation with opaque workload/operation identity only, and handles PlanChanged, accepted, uncertain, and definite pre-dispatch outcomes without retry authority.

Persisted lifecycle rendering, manual Check status, and mounted automatic observation delegate only to the typed reconciliation command; the UI never infers transitions, dispatches, or verifies directly.

Automatic observation is per workload, non-overlapping, roughly five-second cadence, uses the original persisted deadline, stops on terminal/StillRunning/expiry/unmount, and preserves state across temporary observation failures.
API DTOs exclude execution material and configuration internals; the only additional observation datum is the persisted deadline needed to bound the UI timer.

validationCommands.summary: 16 deterministic managed-workload card, review, confirmation, recovery, manual status, automatic observation, deadline, terminal-state, and duplicate-action tests passed.
51 deterministic M17 registry, trust, persistence, PREPARE, consent, exactly-once dispatch, recovery, Activity, and verification tests passed.
Rust check/tests/build; frontend tests/build/lint; AIQT status; and diff check passed. Frontend lint retains four existing Fast Refresh warnings.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The frontend offers only typed workload preparation, opaque confirmation continuation, and same-workload reconciliation; it exposes no generic remote, Docker, systemd, revision, or Service Health authority.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Request DTO serialization tests and frontend tests cover opaque continuation input, absence of sensitive controls, PlanChanged fresh-review behavior, and no retry path for uncertain dispatch.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Lifecycle, recovery, and completion presentation remain backend-authoritative and safe across restart/reopen.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Frontend tests cover persisted active/recoverable display, manual reconciliation, terminal states, no automatic PREPARE/continuation, and no local completion inference; backend lifecycle tests cover the corresponding persisted transitions.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Mounted automatic observation is bounded by the original persisted deadline and cannot overlap, redispatch, or survive terminal/expired/unmounted state.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Fake-timer frontend tests cover cadence, non-overlap, DispatchUncertain observation, deadline expiry, unmount cancellation, terminal stopping, and temporary-failure state preservation.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: WU104 consumes WU102/WU103 execution and verification services without weakening trust, consent, exactly-once dispatch, recovery, verification, completion, or Activity boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The command layer delegates to existing prepare, consent, dispatch, reconciliation, revision/runtime, and final-verification services; 51 managed-workload regressions passed.

notes: No PI 5 or other real device was contacted, inspected, changed, or dispatched.
WU105 deterministic and real-workload operator validation and WU106 regression gates/milestone closure remain future planned work, not WU104 residual work.

Risk at this boundary: 48/100 (Yellow, medium). User-facing deployment authority is sensitive, mitigated by typed fixed backend commands, opaque confirmation, fresh trust/consent gates, exactly-once persistence, same-unit reconciliation, bounded observation, and no generic command surface.
